summary: First-run testing of Man With Van MVP. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed (public /vansizes + /quote, auth register/login/logout/me, full booking flow including admin driver add / assign / status update, role gating). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow passed — homepage loads with hero form, customer registration lands on /account, full 4-step booking wizard produced a live quote and created booking MWVDAC4D74D, tracking page shows map with pickup/dropoff pins + status + ETA + timeline, account history shows booking, logout+login works, customer redirected from /admin to /account, admin login reaches /admin with stats visible, adding driver and assigning to booking + status update via Radix selects all succeeded.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to AddDriverDialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer lifespan handlers.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes password if changed and elevates role — good.

CORS: allow_origins from env with fallback '*' works only because allow_credentials semantics still return credentials=false when origin is '*'; ensure CORS_ORIGINS env is set explicitly in production.
Booking timestamps stored as ISO strings; consistent — good. _id excluded in all read paths — good.
pseudo_distance/pseudo_coords are deterministic and OK for simulation but same pickup==dropoff yields 3.0 miles (intentional min).
No rate limiting on /auth/login (brute-force possible). Playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails — not implemented. Not requested for MVP but flag.
